newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bersani sees car-type incentives spreading.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bersani sees car-type incentives spreading.

text.p: Italy's Minister of Labour Pierluigi Bersani on Wednesday said that Italy's car incentive buying scheme is working well and this type of scheme should be spread to other industrial areas.

"The mechanism seems to be functioning," he told a parliamentary industry commission, "Now we must give measures to help other sectors such as the building industry and above all small and medium-sized companies," he added.

Italy introduced its car buying incentive scheme in early January to last until the end of September. Under the scheme car owners who trade in their cars of over 10 years old can receive price discounts for buying new cars.
